sources.note: Non-commercial last resort, justified in the PR: the only checked source with an explicit typical wild lifespan (5 years). Its lifespan sentence has no cited source, and its own 151-month wild average conflicts with it. Mass, length, wingspan, breeding, diet and behaviour text is also from this account.

range.note: Derived from Wikipedia subspecies list (distribution by subspecies), excluding the Chihuahuan meadowlark (S. lilianae/auropectoralis, split 2022). The split taxon's US range (W Texas and south-west) cannot be excluded at country level; US is a coarse proxy.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: ADW: walks and runs on the ground; flies by beating wings then gliding.

traits.nest_type.note: ADW: nest on the ground in a shallow depression. Wikipedia: nests placed on the ground.

traits.perching.note: Not stated in checked text; judgement from perching on posts for song (Wikipedia: song from perch implied only).

traits.size_class.note: Derived from traits.mass_kg per schema thresholds.

traits.mass_kg.note: Midpoint of ADW 90-150 g adult mass range. Wikipedia gives 76-150 g; the two disagree and ADW was used.

traits.mass_range_kg.note: ADW 90-150 g (Physical Description). Wikipedia 76-150 g disagrees.

traits.length_m.note: Midpoint of ADW 19-26 cm. Wikipedia gives 19-28 cm.

traits.wingspan_m.note: Midpoint of 35-40 cm (ADW and Wikipedia both give 35-40 cm). Wingspan, not wing chord.

traits.lifespan_y.note: ADW Lifespan/Longevity states 'an expected lifespan of five years in the wild' with no cited source. The same section gives a 151-month average wild lifespan attributed to the Bird Banding Laboratory, which conflicts (about 12.6 years), and AnAge gives 12.6 years as the wild maximum. Used with low confidence because no permissive typical wild value was found. Longest known wild lifespan 9 years is a maximum and is not used.

traits.diet.note: AUTHORED allocation. Wikipedia: about three-quarters of diet is animal (beetles, grasshoppers, crickets) and the rest is grain and seeds, so invertebrate 0.75 and seed 0.25. ADW gives the seasonal pattern used for the months: spring insects (cutworms, grubs, caterpillars), summer beetles and grasshoppers, winter weed seeds and leftover grain. Fruit is mentioned by ADW for winter but not quantified, so it is omitted from the allocation and from the program. Boundary months (Mar, Nov) are not stated in ADW and are assigned by the split.

traits.social.note: ADW: territorial pairs in the breeding season; loose flocks in fall and winter. group_size is judgement.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Judgement: daytime foraging and singing in sources; no explicit activity-pattern statement.

traits.defense.note: Judgement. Flushes low in flight (ADW describes flight after walking).

habitat.note: Habitat types from ADW (grasslands, pastures, hay fields, roadsides, airports). Stratum shares and resource weights are authored. Seed months Nov-Feb from ADW winter diet. Invertebrate months Mar-Oct from ADW spring and summer diet. Nesting months May-Aug from ADW.

seasonal.note: Strategy ActiveYearRound is descriptive of the resident majority (ADW: most do not migrate). Northern birds leave by late November and return in March (absent phase, region CA only). Breeding 05-25..08-31 and territories 03-01..08-31 from ADW. The migrant share is not sourced and not modelled.

vocalizations.note: Song description from Wikipedia. Season months from ADW territory and breeding timing. Cooldown is judgement.

behavior.note: Species-local BT program. Ground walking forage (ADW), ground roost in grass (ADW), song from perch in spring-summer, nesting months 5-8 (ADW late May to August), flush-and-fly to perch (ADW). Parameters are judgement.

look.note: Authored rendering block. Colours and proportions are judgement, not sourced measurements.

human_tolerance.notes: Judgement. Sourced habitat: grasslands, pastures, hay fields, cropland borders, roadsides, airports (ADW). Placed as an avoider of built-up areas; not sourced.

phases.name: territorial
phases.note: ADW: males establish territories in March and defend them through the breeding season.

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: ADW: breeding occurs from late May to August. Wikipedia: nesting occurs through the summer.

phases.name: absent
phases.note: ADW: birds in the northernmost part of the range migrate; they leave by late November and return by March. Region scoped to CA. Northern US migrants are not scoped, and the migrant share is not sourced. The strategy stays ActiveYearRound because most birds are resident.

vocalizations.description: Pure, melancholy whistles (Wikipedia). Given by males from a perch in the breeding season. Cooldown is judgement.
